long_biography.plain_text:
Allen studied drama at Whitman College before joining her brother in the organization that became Vulcan and later Vale Group. Her operating work ranged from film production and cultural institutions to large civic projects, including the arenas now known as Moda Center and Lumen Field. She also helped establish the Museum of Pop Culture, bringing creative production and institution-building together.

After Paul Allen's death, she assumed a stewardship mandate rather than ordinary personal ownership of the estate's assets. That role placed her at the head of sports and investment organizations while carrying out a long-term charitable plan. Her independent philanthropic work includes conservation through Wild Lives Foundation, alongside board leadership in open bioscience and support for arts, young people and biodiversity.
